what: N cards stand on a ring of radius 2 (three.js, fov 60, camera 4 · phone radius 1.8 · camera 3.24, ring .95x), all facing the camera, and the whole ring rotates. When 10% of the section is visible, one card is picked and the ring lands on it from half a turn back in 1.2s easeOutQuint. Mouse drag turns .02rad per px (max .2 at once) and on release snaps to the nearest card in .6s easeOutQuint. Horizontal wheel turns .01rad per px and snaps after .1s. Touch: after more than 3px sideways it turns .024rad per px, and on release inertia with .9 damping per frame runs before the snap. Hovering a card spawns 18 sparkles at 0.4~0.6 distance around it that converge in .5s, twinkle (.6~.9s life) and vanish. Pressing (within 2px · 200ms) makes 16 sparkles spread horizontally after .3s and twinkle (.03s interval, .5s). That card moves to the center in .6s, after .35s a DOM card appears in its place and flips front 0→360° · back 180→−180° over .9s, then after .75s it grows to 1.71x (phone 1.41) over 1s and fades out — 1.2s later it counts as a card press (click)

options.radius: Ring radius (world units), default 2 — camera is radius ×2 (phone ×1.8)
options.sp: Phone width (px), default 768 — at or below it, radius ×.9 and ring ×.94
options.open-at · open-delay · back-at: When the DOM card appears after the press · until click after that · when the 3D card returns after click (seconds), default .35 · 1.2 · .5
options.start: Section to land on at entry — random (default) or a number from 0
options.pause: When this selector is in the document the loop stops (while a modal is open), default .is-open[role='dialog'], dialog[open]
options.[data-fx-part=card]: One card (child, number of cards = ring cell count) — if there is an img, that photo, otherwise this DOM (background color, vertical gradient, border, corners, text, placeholder photo) is redrawn as it is. Pressing it flips this element in place, enlarges it, and a click goes through. The ratio is css aspect-ratio (--fx-card-ratio, default 326/566)
options.[data-fx-part=front] · [data-fx-part=bac: (optional) front/back faces inside a card — they spin separately when flipped. The back face is not drawn on the 3D face
options.--fx-card-out: Scale multiplier while fading out, default 1.71 (phone 1.41)
options.fx:card-ring-3d: Event fired from the panel just before click — detail is { index, card }

use: …(five sections)
note: three: load three.cjs(r161) as a plain script after three-global.js <script> is loaded as. One plate uses two WebGL contexts (ring and sparkle strip). For fingers, touch-action: pan-y is set on the plate so swiping up or down scrolls the page and only sideways swipes rotate the ring. In the original, a window mousemove fires first during a drag so the last movement is 0 on release, which means after a mouse drag it snaps immediately without inertia — carried over as is
